customer.business: Mascott (working name): customisable cute animated AI mascot agents that chat with visitors and act on a website or SaaS
customer.target: People who build or run a website or a SaaS and would consider adding an AI chat assistant to it (the 'income' figure is the yearly revenue of the business or activity you run)
customer.where: Online, worldwide, mostly Europe and North America, English and French

segments.name: Small SaaS startup team (2-20 people), founder or PM
Web agency or freelancer building sites for clients
Small business / showcase site owner (Wix, WordPress, Webflow)

behaviours.name: Already pays for a chatbot and is OK with it
behaviours.how: Has Intercom, Crisp or Tidio installed; switching means migration work.

behaviours.name: Frustrated with their current chatbot
behaviours.how: Pays for a bot visitors ignore or that answers badly; open to replacing it.

behaviours.name: AI tool collector
behaviours.how: Tries every new AI tool on Product Hunt, keeps maybe one in ten.

behaviours.name: Free-tier first
behaviours.how: Uses free plans as long as possible, upgrades only when forced by a limit.

behaviours.name: Conversion optimiser
behaviours.how: Only pays for things that move a metric; wants proof, A/B tests everything.

behaviours.name: Brand and design obsessed
behaviours.how: Cares a lot about how the site looks and feels; hates generic widgets.

behaviours.name: Builds it themselves
behaviours.how: Developer at heart; would rather wire an LLM API than pay for a SaaS.

behaviours.name: AI sceptic
behaviours.how: Had bad experiences with bots; worries about wrong answers in front of customers.

you hang out on Indie Hackers, X/Twitter or Reddit to discover tools

pitch:
Mascott: an AI guide with a face for your website or app. It answers visitors from your own content and does things for them (finds a product and points at it, adds to cart, fills a form, books a slot, walks a new user through your app).
Works alone OR on top of the chat you already have (Intercom, Crisp, Tidio): no migration. Two looks: cute mascot, or a sober "pro" character. Script under 30 KB, loads after your page.
You stay in control: you choose which actions are allowed, the visitor confirms before anything is submitted or bought, every action is logged, one-click off switch. EU hosting, GDPR data agreement included.
Done-for-you setup: send your URL, within 24 hours we deliver your mascot trained on your site. Built-in A/B test report shows the lift in sign-ups or sales versus no mascot.
Free: 100 conversations/month. Starter 19 EUR/month (1,000 conversations). Growth 49 EUR/month (5,000 conversations, all actions, no badge, A/B report). Agency 149 EUR/month (10 client sites, white-label). Hard caps, no surprise bills. Guarantee: no measured lift after 30 days, that month is refunded.
Panel note: "buys" means you would start PAYING (Starter, Growth or Agency) within your first month, not just use the free plan. Give all four price answers in EUR per month, for the plan you would most likely use.
